verdict.rationale: Conta Simples is a corporate card and banking platform that markets AI-driven alerts and insights. A setting to keep customer data out of AI model training is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers AI training data use, opt-outs or a data-usage policy, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
